import pandas as pd

# Extract years for Adrian Dantley and Brad Davis
dantley_years = df[df['player'] == 'adrian dantley']['years for jazz'].iloc[0]
davis_years = df[df['player'] == 'brad davis']['years for jazz'].iloc[0]

# Parse year ranges
def parse_years(years_str):
    years = []
    parts = years_str.replace(' ', '').split(',')
    for part in parts:
        if '-' in part:
            start, end = map(int, part.split('-'))
            years.extend(range(start, end + 1))
        else:
            years.append(int(part))
    return set(years)

dantley_set = parse_years(dantley_years)
davis_set = parse_years(davis_years)

# Check conditions
condition1 = davis_set.issubset(dantley_set)  # Dantley was on team entire time Davis was
condition2 = len(dantley_set - davis_set) == 4  # Dantley has exactly 4 additional years

answer = condition1 and condition2
